description: This PHP file contains functions for generating system vitals information in XML, HTML, and WML formats, utilizing global variables and external system info objects.

methods.name: xml_vitals
methods.description: Generates an XML string with system vital statistics such as hostname, IP address, kernel version, distribution, uptime, users, load average, and CPU load.

methods.name: html_vitals
methods.description: Creates an HTML table displaying system vital information with graphical CPU load bar.

methods.name: wml_vitals
methods.description: Produces a WML card with system vital details formatted for mobile devices.
